video_description: Turn on, turn down, turn out: diez phrasal verbs con turn. 💡
title: Completa la frase
intro: [cheerful] Lee la frase, piensa la palabra y dila antes que yo.

items.sentence: Turn ____ the TV, I'm trying to sleep.
Can you turn ____ the music? It's too loud.
items.translation: ¿Puedes bajar la música? Está muy alta.

items.sentence: It turned ____ to be a great day.
items.translation: Al final resultó ser un día genial.
La rana se convirtió en príncipe.

verdict: Si te quedaste en la tres, básico. En la siete, intermedio. Y con las diez, experto.
outro: [excited] ¿Hasta qué número llegaste? Cuéntamelo en los comentarios.

english_phrases: Turn off the TV, I'm trying to sleep.
Can you turn down the music? It's too loud.
Turn it up, I can't hear!
Turn around and look at me.
She turned down the job offer.
It turned out to be a great day.
The frog turned into a prince.
You can always turn to me.
full_script: [cheerful] Lee la frase, piensa la palabra y dila antes que yo. Turn on the light, please. Turn off the TV, I'm trying to sleep. Can you turn down the music? It's too loud. Ahora, nivel intermedio. Turn it up, I can't hear! Turn around and look at me. She turned down the job offer. Only ten people turned up. Y ahora, nivel experto. It turned out to be a great day. The frog turned into a prince. You can always turn to me. Si te quedaste en la tres, básico. En la siete, intermedio. Y con las diez, experto. [excited] ¿Hasta qué número llegaste? Cuéntamelo en los comentarios.
